Question:
An unsigned contract draft is 20 months old, but Legal has issued a hold naming that matter. Does the normal 18-month draft deletion option still let us delete it, and what records must we preserve?

Retrieved context (grouped by document):
=== Document: LEGAL-001 — Contract, NDA, and Data Retention Policy ===

[Section: Data Retention]
Chunk ID: f3bdccac-a301-4df5-939d-005cf43d5e52
Score: 0.7515
Content:
Data Retention

Customer contracts must be retained for seven years after expiration. Vendor agreements must be retained for six years after termination. Employee agreements must be retained according to HR retention rules and any legal hold instructions.

Draft contracts that never reach signature may be deleted after 18 months unless they are part of an active dispute, audit, or legal hold. Executed agreements must never be deleted from the contract repository.

[Section: Legal Hold]
Chunk ID: 1b7eecee-b087-4769-8a43-9236f859ff4c
Score: 0.7098
Content:
Legal Hold

When Legal issues a hold notice, normal deletion schedules stop for the named matter. Recipients must preserve email, chat, files, ticket records, and notes that relate to the hold. Managers must confirm that affected team members understand the hold within five business days.

[Section: Current Version]
Chunk ID: 401ca1bc-ceee-40a1-b151-532bcae431d6
Score: 0.5405
Content:
Current Version

Version 1.2 is effective March 1, 2026. It supersedes the November 2025 contract intake checklist. If a deal note, sales deck, or vendor email conflicts with this policy, Legal Operations must resolve the conflict before signature.

[Section: Contract Approval Process]
Chunk ID: 56f368ca-8cf8-4eec-b828-67bb1302a583
Score: 0.5201
Content:
Contract Approval Process

| Contract Type | Legal Review | Finance Review | Final Approver |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard customer order form under USD 25,000 ARR | Optional unless redlines exist | Deal Desk | Sales Manager |
| Customer contract with security addendum | Required | Deal Desk | Sales Director |
| Vendor agreement under USD 10,000 | Required if data processing applies | Finance | Department Manager |
| Vendor agreement USD 10,000 or above | Required | Finance | Department Leader |
| Employment-related agreement | Required | HR Admin | People Leader |

No employee may sign a contract on behalf of Northstar unless they are listed in the signature authority register maintained by Legal Operations.

[Section: Escalation Triggers]
Chunk ID: 7e7c811c-b257-4d95-8df0-3ce9978c5746
Score: 0.5030
Content:
Escalation Triggers

Escalate to Legal before signature when a contract includes uncapped liability, customer audit rights broader than annual review, unusual data residency commitments, indemnity expansion, auto-renewal longer than one year, or commitments to future roadmap functionality.

[Section: Access Notice]
Chunk ID: f10db009-dee2-4cab-9081-6fc64591228d
Score: 0.4580
Content:
Access Notice

This document is restricted to Sales Representatives, Managers, HR Admins, and IT Admins. It contains internal legal operating guidance and should not be shown to general employees or external parties.

=== Document: IT-003 — Data Classification and Handling Policy ===

[Section: Retention Basics]
Chunk ID: 7a5e3a20-eaf8-48e4-962f-0f0467690638
Score: 0.4845
Content:
Retention Basics

Teams should retain records according to the retention schedule in their approved system. This public policy does not include detailed legal retention rules or HR investigation outcomes.

[Section: Storage Rules]
Chunk ID: a3b6b2f3-1997-4c5d-a9de-2c0f6db5b950
Score: 0.4296
Content:
Storage Rules

Internal, Confidential, and Restricted data must be stored in approved company systems. Restricted data must not be downloaded to personal devices. Confidential data should not be stored in local folders unless there is a documented business need.

=== Document: FIN-001 — Expense, Procurement, and Reimbursement Policy ===

[Section: Policy Status]
Chunk ID: 83a57bc9-ac5f-411e-9684-7d80d72edf1f
Score: 0.4417
Content:
Policy Status

This policy is effective February 1, 2026 and replaces the 2025 informal spend guidance. If an older team wiki or email thread lists a different limit, this policy controls unless Finance publishes a newer version.

Employees should submit expenses within 30 calendar days of the transaction date. Expenses submitted after 60 calendar days require manager approval and a Finance Operations exception note.
